theme: Graphite GPU backend and memory-leak fixes
highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, built on Skia m152.
highlights_body: It also fixes several native memory leaks and use-after-free bugs, adds async pixel-read APIs, and ports more hot paths to managed C# for lower overhead.

bullets.detail: Bumps the bundled Skia engine to Chrome milestone m152, with an m151 upstream stability sync merged beforehand.
Adds SkiaSharp bindings for Skia's Graphite GPU backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, giving consumers an early path to the next-generation GPU rendering pipeline.

bullets.lead: Async pixel readback and new native test packages
bullets.detail: Adds a backend-neutral async RequestReadPixels to SKImage and SKSurface, plus a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package with Vulkan tests running on Android and Linux, and containerized test legs for Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server.

bullets.lead: Nano Server font support via FreeType
bullets.detail: Nano Server images now resolve fonts through FreeType instead of relying on unavailable platform font APIs.

bullets.lead: Native memory leaks and use-after-free bugs fixed
bullets.detail: Fixes a use-after-free in SKRegion.SpanIterator by rooting the owning SKRegion, a use-after-free in SKPixmap.ExtractSubset and With* by rooting the pixel source, and a CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak on the SKImage.Create raster failure path.

bullets.lead: Managed performance ports and deterministic binding generation
bullets.detail: Caches the HandleDictionary skip-registration reflection check, avoids an intermediate string allocation in the null-terminated GetEncodedText path, pre-sizes the SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup map, avoids a double buffer copy in SKData.SaveTo, and makes binding generation deterministic across platforms.
Initializes the MSVC environment once per native build instead of repeatedly, and stops pinning a fixed Windows SDK version by default.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType-based font support for Nano Server.
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Initialized the MSVC environment once per native build instead of repeatedly.
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added the Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn.

harfbuzz_summary: No HarfBuzzSharp-facing product changes shipped in this release; the bundled binding was refreshed alongside the Skia update.
